id.description: Stable slug id. Never reused once published.

sourceRef.description: Where a fact comes from. Exactly one of: upstream path (+#section), URL (+retrieved), or video URL (+timestamp).

ref.description: upstream/<repo>/<path>#<section>, or https URL, or video URL

retrieved.description: Required for URLs that are not pinned upstream files

sources.description: May be empty ONLY when unverified is true (enforced by scripts/validate).

point3.description: [x, y, z] in metres, assembly frame, Y-up

licence.description: SPDX identifier of the upstream asset, e.g. Apache-2.0
